title: SPIDER4TianoCore: Enhancing Patch-Propagation for the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2608.23755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose and demonstrate SPIDER4TianoCore, a packaged Python command-line tool that provides integration-stage patch-status evidence for the TianoCore/UEFI firmware supply chain. Given an upstream pre-patch and post-patch pair and prepared downstream targets, the tool reports Vulnerable, Already Patched, Not Applicable, or Uncertain with supporting evidence for maintainer review. Our work is inspired by SPIDER's patch-propagation framing, but SPIDER4TianoCore does not itself prove that a patch is safe to propagate. We evaluate the engine on 20 prepared target/CVE pairs from eight public downstream EDK II repositories and two CVEs. The analyzers produce 10 high-confidence pre-patch matches and four high-confidence post-patch matches, conservatively abstain on six targets, and make no confidently wrong classifications relative to the recorded manual patch-state labels. translated_title: SPIDER4TianoCore：增强TianoCore UEFI固件开发生态系统中的补丁传播
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.23755v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出并演示了SPIDER4TianoCore，一个打包的Python命令行工具，为TianoCore/UEFI固件供应链提供集成阶段的补丁状态证据。给定上游补丁前和补丁后的配对以及准备好的下游目标，该工具报告“易受影响”、“已修补”、“不适用”或“不确定”，并附带供维护者审查的支持证据。我们的工作受SPIDER的补丁传播框架启发，但SPIDER4TianoCore本身并不证明补丁传播是安全的。我们在来自八个公共下游EDK II仓库和两个CVE的20个准备好的目标/CVE对上评估该引擎。分析器产生了10个高置信度的补丁前匹配和4个高置信度的补丁后匹配，保守地对六个目标弃权，并且相对于记录的手动补丁状态标签，没有做出任何高置信度的错误分类。这些初步结果证明了可复现的证据生成。
tldr: SPIDER4TianoCore是一个为TianoCore UEFI固件供应链提供集成阶段补丁状态证据的工具，通过高置信度匹配和保守弃权，实现了无错误分类的可复现补丁传播分析。
en_tdlr: SPIDER4TianoCore is a tool that provides integration-stage patch-status evidence for the TianoCore UEFI firmware supply chain, achieving reproducible patch-propagation analysis with high-confidence matches and conservative abstentions without misclassifications.
